description: Probe-only rejection library for the hipBLASLt Matmul engine (engine name HIPBLASLT_ENGINE, dnn-providers/hipblaslt-provider, builder engines/plans/HipblasltMatmulPlanBuilder.cpp; config config/HIPBLASLT_ENGINE.toml) on gfx950 (the only device available). MIOpen (MIOPEN_ENGINE) has no matmul plan (miopen-provider/engines/plans holds batchnorm, pointwise, activation and convolution plans only), so it declines every graph here and only hipBLASLt's behaviour decides the verdict; the device run is a matmul run of the whole space with both engines registered. A legal float matmul (A [..,M,K] x B [..,K,N] = C [..,M,N], row-major, dense, compute type float, declared alignment 16; quick Matmul/Default, tensors uid 0 = C, 1 = A, 2 = B) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis; every family is a graph the frontend accepts (MatmulNode.hpp pre_validate: equal ranks >= 2, matching K, batch dims pairwise divisible, no dtype or stride check). The `expect` of a case is `declined` where the engine must not take the graph and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (and the reference oracle can grade it); WRONG and CRASH always violate. Source: HipblasltMatmulPlanBuilder.cpp isApplicable (:288-315), HipblasltMatmulPlan.cpp (MatmulParams), HipblasltMatrixLayout.cpp. none: the control, A, B and C share one dtype of float / half / bfloat16: `declined_or_pass`. dt_c_half, dt_c_bf16 (float inputs, half / bfloat16 output), dt_half_to_float, dt_bf16_to_float (16-bit inputs, float output), dt_a_half, dt_b_bf16, dt_ab_half_bf16 (inputs of different types): A, B and C are each checked only against {float, half, bfloat16} (HipblasltMatmulPlanBuilder.cpp:173-187) and the combination is passed through to hipBLASLt (compute type 32F_FAST_16F / 32F_FAST_16BF only when A and B are both half / both bf16, else 32F, HipblasltMatmulPlan.cpp:54-69): whether the heuristic returns an algorithm is hipBLASLt's, `declined_or_pass`. The first four are signatures of the CPU reference (MatmulSignatureKey.hpp:99-133); for the other three an accept cannot be graded and shows as UNEXERCISED. dt_int8, dt_int8_i32, dt_a_int8, dt_double, dt_fp8_half: a dtype outside {float, half, bfloat16} on A, B or C throws at :178-187: `declined`. trans_a, trans_b, trans_ab, trans_c, trans_all: column-major (strides [.., 1, rows]) A, B, C or all: HipblasltMatrixLayout.cpp:32-49 and getTrans (HipblasltMatmulPlan.cpp:33-52) accept stride[-1] == 1 or stride[-2] == 1, so the engine supports transposed operands: `declined_or_pass`. trans_c (column-major output) is the one where the layout built for C (rows = M, cols = N, HipblasltMatrixLayout.cpp:38-43) disagrees with the N x M result of the row-major swap trick (HipblasltMatmulPlan.cpp:157-162); it declines or computes something else, so a WRONG there is a real finding. odd_dims: M, N and K each drawn from values not divisible by 4 (1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 13, 17, 31): no divisibility gate exists in the provider: `declined_or_pass`. rank2: no batch dimension (setBatchInfo is skipped for rank 2, HipblasltMatmulPlan.cpp:165): `declined_or_pass`. bc_a1 / bc_b1: A (B) batch 1 against a batch of nb, the supported broadcast (:184-215, the batch offset of the broadcast operand is not set): `declined_or_pass`. batch4: A and B [2, 3, ..] with dense uniform strides, supported (the offset is strides[rank-3], :209-215, which is right for a dense tensor): `declined_or_pass`. bc4_a1: A [1, 1, M, K] against B [2, 3, K, N]: supported broadcast: `declined_or_pass`. bc4_b_half (A [2, 3] x B [1, 3]), bc4_cross (A [2, 1] x B [1, 3]), bc4_partial (A [1, 3] x B [2, 3]): batch products differ and neither is 1, so setBatchInfo throws at :184-190 (frontend-legal broadcasts the engine cannot express with one strided batch): `declined_or_pass`, a correct engine may support them. bc4_cross_eq (A [1, 2] x B [2, 1] = C [2, 2]): products agree (2 and 2) but C's is 4, throws at :192-198: `declined_or_pass`. bperm_a, bperm_b, bperm_c [gap]: batch dims [2, 3] whose strides are swapped (dense, but the outer batch axis has the larger stride): the engine flattens the batch to cBatch = 6 and uses only strides[rank-3] as the batch offset (:206-215) with no check that the strides are uniform, so a correct result is impossible: expected `declined_or_pass`, an accept is WRONG or a CRASH (out-of-range batch offsets) and violates regardless. align_low: declared alignment 1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes on A, B and C with odd M, N, K: the provider never reads the declared alignment (grep finds no use in the plan builder or plan), so the engine accepts or declines on hipBLASLt's heuristic alone and the backend's execute-time pointer check passes (the device pointers are 256-byte aligned): `declined_or_pass`. overflow_elems, overflow_dims, overflow_ld: three overflow families, each indexing four variants with the axis `ovi` (0-3) at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed); the variant pushes one field past the int32 / uint32 limit. overflow_elems: a_elems / b_elems / c_elems (an operand of 2**31 elements), batch_elems; overflow_dims: m_dim / k_dim / n_dim (a dimension of 2**32), batch_count; overflow_ld: ld_a / ld_b / ld_c, batch_stride. Variants: a_elems / b_elems / c_elems (an operand of 2**31 elements), batch_elems (batch 2**15 x 2**8 x 2**8 = 2**31 elements of C), m_dim / k_dim / n_dim (a dimension of 2**32), ld_a / ld_b / ld_c (a leading dimension of 2**31), batch_stride (A batch stride 2**31, batch 2), batch_count (batch 2**31 of 1 x 1 matrices: hipblasLtMatrixLayoutSetAttribute receives the batch count as int64, HipblasltMatrixLayout.cpp:110-117, where hipBLASLt's own count is 32-bit). The provider has no overflow gate: rows, cols and ld are passed as uint64 / int64 to hipblasLtMatrixLayoutCreate (HipblasltMatrixLayout.cpp:28-55) and the batch offset as int64, so everything depends on hipBLASLt; the expectation is `declined` (a kernel launched with 32-bit offsets would truncate). An accepted and built overflow case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`, never PASS. Known gaps (a WRONG / CRASH or an overflow accept is a finding): bperm_a, bperm_b, bperm_c, trans_c, overflow_elems, overflow_dims, overflow_ld. Never frozen into a bundle.

derive.ovf: (['a_elems', 'b_elems', 'c_elems', 'batch_elems'][ovi] if family == 'overflow_elems' else (['m_dim', 'k_dim', 'n_dim', 'batch_count'][ovi] if family == 'overflow_dims' else (['ld_a', 'ld_b', 'ld_c', 'batch_stride'][ovi] if family == 'overflow_ld' else 'none')))
derive.m_e: 1 if ov and ovf == 'batch_count' else (2**32 if ov and ovf == 'm_dim' else (2**16 if ov and ovf in ['a_elems', 'c_elems'] else (2**8 if ov and ovf == 'batch_elems' else (16 if ov else (odd_m if is_odd else m)))))
derive.k_e: 1 if ov and ovf == 'batch_count' else (2**32 if ov and ovf == 'k_dim' else (2**15 if ov and ovf == 'a_elems' else (2**16 if ov and ovf == 'b_elems' else (16 if ov else (odd_k if is_odd else k)))))
derive.n_e: 1 if ov and ovf == 'batch_count' else (2**32 if ov and ovf == 'n_dim' else (2**15 if ov and ovf in ['b_elems', 'c_elems'] else (2**8 if ov and ovf == 'batch_elems' else (16 if ov else (odd_n if is_odd else n)))))
derive.nb_e: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'batch_count' else (2**15 if ov and ovf == 'batch_elems' else (2 if ov and ovf == 'batch_stride' else (1 if ov else nb)))
derive.ba: ([] if family == 'rank2' else ([1] if family == 'bc_a1' else ([nb_e] if family == 'bc_b1' else ([2, 3] if family == 'batch4' else ([1, 1] if family == 'bc4_a1' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_b_half' else ([2, 1] if family == 'bc4_cross' else ([1, 2] if family == 'bc4_cross_eq' else ([1, 3] if family == 'bc4_partial' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_a' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_b' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_c' else [nb_e]))))))))))))
derive.bb: ([] if family == 'rank2' else ([nb_e] if family == 'bc_a1' else ([1] if family == 'bc_b1' else ([2, 3] if family == 'batch4' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_a1' else ([1, 3] if family == 'bc4_b_half' else ([1, 3] if family == 'bc4_cross' else ([2, 1] if family == 'bc4_cross_eq' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_partial' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_a' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_b' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_c' else [nb_e]))))))))))))
derive.bc: ([] if family == 'rank2' else ([nb_e] if family == 'bc_a1' else ([nb_e] if family == 'bc_b1' else ([2, 3] if family == 'batch4' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_a1' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_b_half' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_cross' else ([2, 2] if family == 'bc4_cross_eq' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bc4_partial' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_a' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_b' else ([2, 3] if family == 'bperm_c' else [nb_e]))))))))))))
derive.lda: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'ld_a' else k_e
derive.ldb: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'ld_b' else n_e
derive.ldc: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'ld_c' else n_e
derive.blk_a: 2**31 if ov and ovf == 'batch_stride' else (m_e * k_e if tA else m_e * lda)
derive.blk_b: k_e * n_e if tB else k_e * ldb
derive.blk_c: m_e * n_e if tC else m_e * ldc
derive.stride_a: ([] if len(ba) == 0 else ([blk_a] if len(ba) == 1 else ([blk_a, 2 * blk_a] if family == 'bperm_a' else [ba[1] * blk_a, blk_a]))) + ([1, m_e] if tA else [lda, 1])
derive.stride_b: ([] if len(bb) == 0 else ([blk_b] if len(bb) == 1 else ([blk_b, 2 * blk_b] if family == 'bperm_b' else [bb[1] * blk_b, blk_b]))) + ([1, k_e] if tB else [ldb, 1])
derive.stride_c: ([] if len(bc) == 0 else ([blk_c] if len(bc) == 1 else ([blk_c, 2 * blk_c] if family == 'bperm_c' else [bc[1] * blk_c, blk_c]))) + ([1, m_e] if tC else [ldc, 1])
derive.dta: ('float' if family == 'dt_c_half' else ('float' if family == 'dt_c_bf16' else ('half' if family == 'dt_half_to_float' else ('bfloat16' if family == 'dt_bf16_to_float' else ('half' if family == 'dt_a_half' else ('float' if family == 'dt_b_bf16' else ('half' if family == 'dt_ab_half_bf16' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_int8' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_int8_i32' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_a_int8' else ('double' if family == 'dt_double' else ('fp8_e4m3' if family == 'dt_fp8_half' else dtype))))))))))))
derive.dtb: ('float' if family == 'dt_c_half' else ('float' if family == 'dt_c_bf16' else ('half' if family == 'dt_half_to_float' else ('bfloat16' if family == 'dt_bf16_to_float' else ('float' if family == 'dt_a_half' else ('bfloat16' if family == 'dt_b_bf16' else ('bfloat16' if family == 'dt_ab_half_bf16' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_int8' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_int8_i32' else ('float' if family == 'dt_a_int8' else ('double' if family == 'dt_double' else ('fp8_e4m3' if family == 'dt_fp8_half' else dtype))))))))))))
derive.dtc: ('half' if family == 'dt_c_half' else ('bfloat16' if family == 'dt_c_bf16' else ('float' if family == 'dt_half_to_float' else ('float' if family == 'dt_bf16_to_float' else ('float' if family == 'dt_a_half' else ('float' if family == 'dt_b_bf16' else ('float' if family == 'dt_ab_half_bf16' else ('int8' if family == 'dt_int8' else ('int32' if family == 'dt_int8_i32' else ('float' if family == 'dt_a_int8' else ('double' if family == 'dt_double' else ('half' if family == 'dt_fp8_half' else dtype))))))))))))

constraints.rule: ov or (m_e * k_e + k_e * n_e + m_e * n_e) * nb_e * 6 <= 2**20
constraints.reason: oracle cost ceiling for the non-overflow families (at most a batch of 6 matrices); the overflow families are built, never run
